data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: achievement
sections.summary: Something accomplished successfully, especially through effort, skill or courage; also the act of accomplishing something successfully.

senses.definition: something successfully accomplished, especially through effort, skill or determination
examples: Winning the national championship was the greatest achievement of her sporting career.

senses.definition: the process of successfully completing something difficult or reaching an important goal
examples: The achievement of her goals required years of dedication and hard work.

answers.answer: Publishing her first novel at the age of twenty-five was a remarkable personal achievement.
He showed great achievement in carrying all the heavy boxes up to the third floor by himself.
She had an achievement in her school bag that she took to the careers adviser every week.
The achievement was very comfortable and offered a wonderful view from the corner office window.

sections.question: commitment
sections.summary: A strong sense of dedication to a cause, activity or person; also a promise or obligation to do something.

senses.definition: the willingness to give a lot of your time and energy to something you believe in
examples: Her commitment to the project was evident from the long hours she put in every single week.

senses.definition: a promise or firm decision to do something
examples: The company made a public commitment to reduce its carbon emissions by fifty percent.

answers.answer: Her commitment to improving her skills led her to study every evening for over a year.
She felt great commitment when the difficult project was finally completed and delivered on time.
He put his commitment in an envelope and handed it to the manager before leaving the office.
The commitment was very comfortable and had an excellent view of the city from the window.

sections.question: dedication
sections.summary: The quality of being fully committed to a task or purpose; the willingness to put in sustained effort over time.

senses.definition: great commitment and effort given to a particular task, cause or person over a sustained period
examples: Her dedication to learning new skills made her one of the most valued members of the team.

senses.definition: a message at the beginning of a book, piece of music or work of art, expressing who it was made for
examples: The dedication in his first novel read: 'For my mother, who always believed in me.'

answers.answer: It was through sheer dedication and years of practice that she became a concert pianist.
She wore her dedication to every interview and always created an excellent first impression.
He had a lot of dedication in his briefcase that he presented to the potential investors.
The dedication was very tasty and all the guests enjoyed it at the end-of-year awards dinner.

sections.question: leadership
sections.summary: The ability to guide, inspire and direct a group of people towards a common goal; also the position of being the leader of a group or organisation.

senses.definition: the ability to guide, motivate and direct others towards a shared goal
examples: Her leadership skills were praised by the entire team after the project's successful completion.

senses.definition: the position or state of being the leader of a group, party or organisation
examples: He took over the leadership of the department after the previous director retired.

answers.answer: Her strong leadership kept the team focused and motivated throughout the most difficult phase of the project.
He showed great leadership in carrying all the heavy equipment up to the conference room alone.
She wore her leadership to the annual staff ceremony and received many compliments on the evening.
The leadership was very comfortable and offered a beautiful view of the surrounding countryside.

sections.question: motivation
sections.summary: The desire or drive to do or achieve something; also the reason or reasons behind a person's actions or behaviour.

senses.definition: enthusiasm and determination to do or achieve something
examples: His motivation to succeed came from a strong desire to provide a better life for his family.

senses.definition: the reason or reasons that cause someone to act in a particular way
examples: The detective tried to understand the motivation behind the suspect's actions.

answers.answer: She struggled to find the motivation to study after a long and exhausting week at work.
He felt great motivation after eating a large meal and decided to take a short rest on the sofa.
She put her motivation in her bag and used it every morning before she started her daily tasks.
The motivation was very comfortable and had an excellent view of the surrounding hills and fields.
